summary: Pre-market, 2026-10-12. The composite stands at 51.2 in the caution band, up 0.45 on the day, inside an unchanged goldilocks regime at a 0.9055 model confidence. The freshest leg is mainland China, where the 2026-10-12 close was a broad semiconductor and storage drawdown: all 11 tracked names fell, from 688008.sh at -2.915 to 300475.sz at -5.3372, and 603986.sh is now -13.2967 over the week. The last completed US session, 2026-10-09, was mixed rather than directional: TSLA 2.0533 and AVGO 0.3887 higher against AMD -2.0268, MU -0.6603 and NVDA -0.5207, with the semis basket at -0.7047. Software and platform verticals still led on that tape, with cybersecurity 3.5782, enterprise software 2.8105, cloud computing 2.7918 and AI software 2.6229 against quantum computing -1.495. The rates and volatility legs advanced one vintage to 2026-10-08 and eased at the long end: the 10Y at 5.22 against 5.28, the real 10Y at 2.87 against 2.92 and the 2s10s spread at 0.47 against 0.51, while HY OAS widened to 3.15 from 3.09. Breadth is the weak spot: 0.5613 of 155 names above their 200-day average, with small caps -8.8787 and semis -2.8785 relative. The dollar leg is still frozen on its 2026-10-02 vintage at 121.3848 and feeds the largest single driver.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation remains the largest single contribution at 7.5, reading 0.375 with 3 of the 8 production signals triggered, and it is a proxy discounted to 0.8 with a pinned 50.0 risk score.
The macro block is the binding constraint at 72.59: the 10Y real rate at 2.87 sits at the 99.36 percentile, the 10Y yield at 5.22 scores 98.72, the 2s10s spread narrowed to 0.47 and the 2Y is 4.75.
HY OAS widened to 3.15, contributing 5.0992, and remains the second-largest driver inside a liquidity and credit block that has been flat at 61.43.
Reverse repo contributed 3.8396 while its level sits at 0.3, the 2.01 percentile, which the neutral direction maps to a 95.99 risk score, a pinned mapping rather than a fresh signal.
Breadth weakened again: 0.5613 of 155 names sit above their 200-day average, the new-low ratio is 0.1026 against a new-high ratio of 0.109, and small caps are -8.8787 relative.

supporting_signals.claim: Software and platform verticals carried the last completed US session: cybersecurity 3.5782, enterprise software 2.8105, cloud computing 2.7918, AI software 2.6229 and gaming 2.6769.
The momentum and drawdown legs stay constructive: the index sits 7.6967 above its 200-day average, the 52-week drawdown is only -0.0667 and three-month momentum is 3.9243.
Low volatility remains the main offset: VIX at 15.41 sits at the 26.98 percentile and realized volatility at 9.9819 rounds to a 10.0 risk score, keeping the volatility block at 19.06.
Credit outside the high-yield tail is calm: IG OAS held at 0.82 and the Fed balance sheet rose to 6747560 from 6743031.
Crypto traded firmer over the past 24 hours: BTC 83339 up 0.46911, ETH 2550.76 up 2.02241 and SOL 111.22 up 1.70325, with BTC dominance at 0.594905.

contradicting_signals.claim: The composite rose only 0.45 to 51.2 while the freshest equity tape, mainland China, fell broadly: all 11 tracked names closed lower, from -2.915 to -5.3372.
The 10Y real rate at 2.87 still sits at the 99.36 percentile, so the easing at the long end has not changed the level of the constraint.
The largest driver partly rests on a dollar index frozen at 121.3848 from the 2026-10-02 vintage, and it is a proxy at a 0.8 discount.

The consumer electronics basket at -5.547 is a single-constituent reading: it equals the 2026-10-12 move of its Hong Kong constituent, not a broad sector drawdown, because the basket renormalizes over the members that traded on both dates.
Breadth did not confirm the software bid: the new-low ratio at 0.1026 is close to the new-high ratio of 0.109 across 156 names, and semi relative performance is -2.8785.

what_changed_today: The mainland China close is new to this brief and it was a broad drawdown: all 11 tracked storage and semiconductor names fell on 2026-10-12, led by 300475.sz at -5.3372, 688825.sh at -5.2157 and 300223.sz at -5.0196.
The US leg is now the settled 2026-10-09 close rather than the pre-close snapshot the previous layer carried: NVDA -0.5207, AMD -2.0268, MU -0.6603, AVGO 0.3887 and TSLA 2.0533.
The composite rose to 51.2 from 50.75, with the macro block at 72.59 from 71.16 the largest contributor to the move.

The rates leg advanced one vintage to 2026-10-08 and eased: the 10Y at 5.22 against 5.28, the 2Y at 4.75 against 4.77 and the real 10Y at 2.87 against 2.92, while the 2s10s spread narrowed to 0.47 from 0.51.
Credit widened and volatility held: HY OAS 3.15 against 3.09 and IG OAS 0.82, with VIX unchanged at 15.41 because the volatility leg is still the 2026-10-08 vintage.
Breadth slipped: 0.5613 of 155 names above their 200-day average from 0.5742, and the new-low ratio at 0.1026 from 0.0962.
The consumer electronics theme printed -5.547 against 0.6234 previously; that value is exactly the 2026-10-12 move of its Hong Kong constituent and is a single-name reading, not a sector move.
The memory theme printed only -0.078 even though 7 of its Asian members closed 4 to 5 percent lower on 2026-10-12, so the mixed-session basket is not a usable read on the mainland memory tape.
Reverse repo printed 0.3 against 0.335 and the Fed balance sheet rose to 6747560 from 6743031.
watch_next: US CPI on 2026-10-14 is the next high-importance macro print and the cleanest test of whether the hike priced at 4.075 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88 survives.
PPI and advance retail sales follow on 2026-10-15, the same day TSM reports.
The US bank earnings cluster opens on 2026-10-13 with JPM, C, GS, JNJ, UNH and WFC, followed by BAC on 2026-10-14.
Whether the software bid on the last completed session broadens into hardware, where the semis basket is -0.7047 and semi relative performance is -2.8785.
Whether HY OAS keeps widening past 3.15 and whether the real 10Y at 2.87 pushes further beyond the 99.36 percentile.
Whether the mainland semiconductor drawdown stabilizes, given 603986.sh is -13.2967 over the week and 300475.sz is -19.9249.
Whether breadth repairs, with the new-high ratio at 0.109 against a new-low ratio of 0.1026, and whether the dollar leg refreshes from its 2026-10-02 vintage.
Whether the mainland policy calendar moves risk appetite: the financial forum opens next week and a new-energy vehicle export tax rebate change has been announced.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the software bid broadens
points: Cybersecurity at 3.5782 and cloud computing at 2.7918 keep leading and pull AI infrastructure up from 0.0581.
VIX at 15.41 holds the lower part of its range and the volatility block at 19.06 keeps the composite contained.
Breadth at 0.5613 above the 200-day average holds and the composite drifts back below 51.2.

base_case.title: Base case: regional divergence, no resolution
points: The composite oscillates near 51.2 while the macro block at 72.59 remains the binding constraint.
The mainland drawdown from -2.915 to -5.3372 and the steadier US tape offset each other.
Credit and volatility offset the equity rebound, with HY OAS at 3.15 and VIX at 15.41.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the mainland drawdown spreads and credit breaks
points: The mainland semiconductor and storage drawdown, from -4.2124 to -5.3372 on 2026-10-12, extends into a second session and drags the Asian tape.
HY OAS breaks above 3.15 while the real 10Y at 2.87 and the 10Y at 5.22 push beyond their percentile extremes.
Breadth at 0.5613 breaks lower with the new-low ratio above 0.1026, and the composite pushes above 60.
